title: Tenma Tsukasa — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
We've really made the most of our time after school!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have triumphed over ice cream, beef skewers, kebabs with no vegetables, and even mutton biryani!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think we outdid some of the latest vacuum cleaners out there. Now my stomach is making awful noises.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though, it was surprisingly fun to spend the afternoon pretending to be competitive eaters. We should do this again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
If only school always got out this early.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On the other hand, that may get old rather quickly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You may be right...
Especially considering how much I enjoy being chased around by the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the only one who feels that way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, we do get to be in class together this year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, but different faces around us... A new environment... Don't they just fill you with excitement?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, they do.
I'm looking forward to seeing what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to eat, it is time to come up with a theme for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you see?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, look...
This sweater vest. I'm feeling some sort of profound connection to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This tepid embroidered fish... Isn't this from that clothing brand you like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it appears to be so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this sweater vest... It balances cute and cool so perfectly that I can't help but gravitate towards it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I must have it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, why don't you try it on?
I'll wait here for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, I'll be but a moment!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Excuse me!!
Would you be able to direct me to the fitting rooms?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He's as energetic as ever today.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
This looks stunning on you, sir!
And it fits just right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I didn't intend to try on a whole outfit centered around this sweater vest, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I like it...
I may just have to buy the entire thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Tsukasa, you're done changing.
That outfit looks very nice on you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah. Doesn't it?
So nice that I'm seriously considering buying all of it now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't see any problem with that if you like it that much. Plus, it is the best time of year to get something new.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Coming across the perfect outfit at the perfect time. Perhaps this is fate...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't have much cash on hand, but I may just have to take the plunge! Like diving from the Kiyomizu Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How much would this all be together?!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Thank you for shopping with us today!
That'll be 25,800 yen.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: 25-thousand?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I really went for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No problem at all. Watching you pick out a new outfit also gave me a new perspective.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As expected, the start of a new term is the best time to switch things up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. The change in our class marks a fresh start! I'd like to make the most of this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are about to embark upon a new journey as Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're about to make the climb towards stardom, taking the world by storm and making our dreams a reality!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's change our outlook and face that challenge head-on!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Let's go out there and make our dreams come true.
